sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the conditional requirement: only a true fireSafetyComponentExposed value triggers validation, and that case requires iceAndSnowProtectionPresent to be true. Absent exposure evidence does not fail, the supplied ship target and canonical terms are used, datatypes are correct, and deterministic validation is valid.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the conditional logic so an absent fireSafetyComponentExposed value does not fail the shape. The requirement constrains only the true case; the current sh:minCount 1 and false-valued branch incorrectly require exposure evidence and create an accidental existence obligation.
